newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gucci shares up after record H1 net.
newsitem.headline: Gucci shares up after record H1 net.

text.p: Shares in Amsterdam bourse listed Gucci rose almost seven percent at Thursday's open, after the luxury goods maker posted record first half profits.

The stock opened up 8.30 guilders at 132.00 after posting a first half profit of 69.9 million dollars versus 26.4 million in the same period a year ago. By 0755 GMT the stock had pared its gains to trade up 5.30 guilders at 129.00.
